bio.text: Jim Wooten is serving his fourth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 59.
The legislature's member page lists his occupation as retired, and the House lists his address as Beebe.
For the 95th General Assembly he serves on the House Insurance and Commerce Committee, the House Revenue and Taxation Committee and the Joint Budget Committee.
